نشترع (form VIII)
# نَشْتَرِعُ (naštariʕu) /naʃ.ta.ri.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# نُشْتَرَعُ (nuštaraʕu) /nuʃ.ta.ra.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# نَشْتَرِعَ (naštariʕa) /naʃ.ta.ri.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# نُشْتَرَعَ (nuštaraʕa) /nuʃ.ta.ra.ʕa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
